scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "corepack pnpm --filter @episignal/web dev" "uv run --package episignal-api python -m episignal_api.run"
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm lint:web && corepack pnpm lint:python
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check . && corepack pnpm --filter @episignal/web exec prettier --check .
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm typecheck:web && uv run mypy apps/api/src packages/backend/src
scripts.test: corepack pnpm test:web && uv run pytest
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --package episignal-api python -m episignal_api.export_openapi && corepack pnpm --filter @episignal/contracts generate
scripts.contracts:check: corepack pnpm contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package episignal-api alembic -c database/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:rollback: uv run --package episignal-api alembic -c database/alembic.ini downgrade -1
scripts.ingest:who: uv run --package episignal-backend python -m episignal_backend.ingest_runner who-don
scripts.ingest:ecdc: uv run --package episignal-backend python -m episignal_backend.ingest_runner ecdc-epi
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm contracts:check && corepack pnpm build
